name: bluerock
description: The tools that come with BlueRock for Builders. They run inside your AI Work Hub, the repo you set up in the curriculum. A research team sizes up any company and hands back a one-page Account Scorecard: Fit, Timing, Reachability, and the recommended next step. Onboarding learns how you write, a living list holds your daily priorities, and an end-of-day wrap-up keeps your dashboard current. Everything it writes is plain markdown in your own repo.
